title: A convenient synthesis of diacyl sulfides using a novel sulfur transfer reagent
abstract: AbstractVarious diacyl sulfides were synthesized by reaction of acyl chlorides with LiAlHSH. Reaction of glutaryl chloride with LiAlHSH afforded glutaric thioanhydride. © 2003 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Heteroatom Chem 14:633–635, 2003; Published online in Wiley InterScience (www.interscience.wiley.com). DOI 10.1002/hc.10217
